title: The passive voice: free practice
instructionEs: Escribe, transforma y corrige las frases.

items.text: In this hotel, the rooms ___ (to clean) every morning.
items.explanationEs: Algo que se hace siempre: pasiva en presente, are + participio.

items.text: The Mona Lisa ___ (to paint) by Leonardo da Vinci.
items.explanationEs: Algo terminado en el pasado: was + participio.

items.text: The new hospital ___ (to open) next year.
items.explanationEs: Pasiva en futuro: will be + participio (o is going to be + participio).

answers: My wallet was stolen by someone.
items.explanationEs: Lo robado pasa a sujeto y to be va en pasado: was stolen. By someone no aporta nada y suele omitirse.

items.source: They make these cars in Japan.
answers: These cars are made in Japan.
items.explanationEs: These cars pasa a sujeto, are + participio (made). By them no aporta nada: se omite.

items.sentence: The cake was ate by the children.
items.explanationEs: Después de was, el participio: eaten. Ate es el pasado.
